verdict.rationale: Agora ships a conversational voice-agent platform that integrates LLMs, so letting its agents call tools from external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows Agora offering its own MCP server for coding agents to use (agora-docs-1). That is the server role and does not show Agora consuming third-party MCP servers. Nothing in the pack documents the ability to plug in external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
